m.e: All you have to do is make-believe... to this man here.

m.e: Jill wanted to see how it looked on me before she did it.

m.e: And I'm not doing it to her.

m.e: I can't do it to her.

m.e: Do you really want to do this to them?

m.t: También puedo hacérselo a ustedes.
m.e: I can frame you, too.

m.e: We should let sinclair know.

m.e: I just need to make her see, OK?

m.e: I just want to make it real for her.

m.e: What's important is, and I'm gonna make it come true.

m.e: You can do this however you have to, but you don't get to do it to him, okay?

m.t: No pueden hacérselo a su esposa y se desquitan con ustedes.
m.e: They can't do that to their wife so they take it out on you.

m.t: Podías hacérselo a ella por ayudar a su hermano.
m.e: You could make it up to her by helping her brother.

m.t: Si me uno a ellos... podrían hacérselo pasar muy mal a Pasha.
m.e: If I got in with them... they could make things really bad for Pasha.

m.t: Hay que hacérselo ver.
m.e: And they must be made to!

m.t: Es como si ese sujeto no nos escuchara cuando intentamos hacérselo entender, viejo.

m.t: Creí que el Sr. McBride estaba... fuera de lugar y que debíamos hacérselo saber.
